longName: Sample set — how to use OK Trainer

cards.front: How do you flip a card to see the answer?
cards.back: Tap the card, or press the space bar.

cards.front: What does the color of the bar in the statistics mean?
cards.back: Red = poor results, orange = somewhere in between, green = you know it reliably.
Into areas and subareas — pick an area at the top, then a specific subarea below it, or "all".

cards.front: What does the "reset stats for selected (sub)area" button do?
cards.back: It resets the saved success rate for that (sub)area; the card content stays unchanged.

cards.front: What does the 🎧 "Start handsfree mode" button do?
cards.back: It turns on voice reading of the cards, controlled with the Next/Previous track buttons on your headset or watch.

cards.front: How do you hear the question again?
cards.back: Press Prev/Previous track while the card is still showing its front side.

cards.front: Where do the questions come from?
cards.back: From an imported JSON file — you can create your own set.

cards.front: What happens if you import a set with the same short name as one that's already imported?
cards.back: All statistics for that set will be reset.
